response.sql: WITH country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean1 FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - m1.mean1 AS excess1 FROM country_avg ca, m1 WHERE ca.avg_wins > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean2 FROM above), final AS (SELECT a.avg_wins, a.excess1, a.avg_wins - m2.mean2 AS excess2 FROM above a, m2 WHERE a.avg_wins > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(excess1) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean, AVG(excess2) AS mean_excess_over_above_group_mean FROM final;

assumptions.assumption: Each country's average is the mean over its constructorStandings rows (row-weighted), not an average of per-circuit or per-race averages.
The 'mean of all country averages' is an unweighted mean of the per-country averages, with each country counting equally.
Countries with no standings rows are excluded because of the inner joins. Circuits with a NULL country would form their own group, which seems unlikely.
